purpose: Compare the latest official monthly weighted-average interest rate for one Treasury security category to a caller threshold.

decisions.threshold_met: The uniquely selected Treasury average rate satisfies the requested comparison.
decisions.threshold_not_met: The uniquely selected Treasury average rate does not satisfy the requested comparison.
decisions.human_review: The security description is missing/ambiguous or the published rate is unavailable.

claim_boundaries: the source is the monthly weighted average interest rate on outstanding Treasury securities
the result is not a live Treasury market yield
the result is not a forecast or investment recommendation
the result does not represent the rate on a specific new Treasury issuance
